title: Etched terraces
description: Fine cyan scanlines bend over two stepped reliefs on a saturated red field.
useCase: Generative architectural textures, art direction, and dimensional line artwork.
interaction: Adjust relief and pause the moving engraving
reducedMotion: The line field remains still; relief adjustment redraws immediately.
limitations: Canvas 2D height-field illustration, not a volumetric mesh or physical surface.
look: Saturated red field with a dense mesh of thin cyan scanlines and faint verticals lifted over two stepped pyramidal reliefs, minimal cyan controls below.
motion: Two stepped square reliefs rock slowly in rotation under a mesh of scanlines, with a sine ripple travelling across raised areas; a slider sets relief height and a button pauses.
adapt: Everything draws in `draw`: `field` builds two stepped square height maps (8 terraces, rocking by `Math.sin(time.current * 0.16) * 0.09`), and scanlines step `2.6` px with ripple `Math.sin(x * 0.07 + time.current * 0.7)`. Tune `relief`, `#e31b32` and `#5ce4ec`.
